result.title: Yes, with a human review
result.text: Someone who understands the subject must review the output before it is shared. Verify facts, figures and references.

result.title: Only with review and approvals
result.text: Review the content yourself, then get the approvals listed on the tool page (for example Communications for generated images). Check licences for generated code and media.

result.title: Not without an approved assessment
result.text: Automated or AI-assisted decisions that affect people need an approved assessment first. Contact Information Security and HR before you start.

result.title: No: Confidential data cannot go to cloud tools
result.text: Approved cloud tools only accept Public and Internal data. Ask the AI Platform Team about the self-hosted option, which needs approval.

result.title: Only on approved, managed hardware
result.text: Confidential data may be processed by self-hosted models if your approval covers it and you run on managed hardware, never a personal laptop.

result.title: No: Restricted data never goes into an AI tool
result.text: Customer personal data, credentials and similar data must not be entered, even in an approved tool. Anonymise it first or do the task another way.

result.title: Treat it as one level higher
result.text: When you are not sure, treat the data as one classification level above your best guess, and ask Information Security before using it.

result.title: Get the approval first
result.text: Restricted tools may only be used with written sign-off. Request it through the challenge board or the tool owner listed on the tool page.

result.title: No: personal and free accounts are not covered
result.text: They may use your input for training and offer no contractual protection, whatever the data. Use the enterprise assistant instead.

result.title: Not until it is reviewed
result.text: Tools that are not in the catalogue have not been assessed. Request a review so everyone can benefit if it is approved.
